0022600174.text: The Washington Wizards (4-3, 1st in the Southeast and 6th in the East, winners of two straight) host the Atlanta Hawks (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast and 7th in the East, 0.5 games back in the division, winners of their last game) in the Wizards' eighth game of the 2026-27 season. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Alex Sarr (knee soreness) and Anthony Gill (back spasms) are day-to-day and gametime decisions. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), with Jalen Johnson (ankle) and Jock Landale (hip) also day-to-day gametime decisions, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 126-96 defeat in Atlanta on February 26, 2026.
